scope: Noncommercial retrospective predictive diagnostic, no trading/PnL or live approval

source.license: Binance Vision Dataset Terms v1.0; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 unless otherwise designated; noncommercial research only

label: Prediction at completed close i: 1 iff Binance daily close[i+2] > open[i+2], otherwise 0. Uses actual primary candle open/close, no fabricated opens.
features: Same frozen ONLINE-LOOP-001 features: intercept; clipped [-5,5] log return1*100, log return5*20, population std last20 log returns*100; only observed closes
training: Identical initial weights; train labels completed by end of 2022 only. Score original stored forecast before adaptive SGD update; fixed never updates. Adaptive carries state across reporting epochs. No tuning or resets after seeing results.
audit_gate: Require pinned immutable artifact metadata; re-audit all original zips/checksums/receipts/coverage in runner; hash candidate CSV; no secondary-source override. Coherence and CI provenance review permit predictive diagnostics only, not general market execution approval.
publication_availability: Retrospective index-causal replay, not verified historical publication timestamps/vintages. A 2-session target does not prove point-in-time feed availability.
reproducibility: Run twice, exact equality of all metric dictionaries and initial snapshot. Ledger hashes differ due to actual write timestamps. Preserve full records in artifact and only bounded aggregates in GitHub Check API.
not_performed: current fees and symbol filter verification
comparability: CoinMetrics close-to-close reference labels differ from Binance intraday labels; do not treat scores as an apples-to-apples provider comparison.
selection: No winner promotion, holdout independence or statistical significance claim. Epochs already inspected historically. No further model search based on these scores.
